client_type.description: residential = private home/apartment owner; developer = residential complex or cottage town; partner = designer/architect bringing a client

services.description: Services explicitly requested or clearly implied. Empty array if unclear

area_m2.description: Object area in square meters. 0 if not stated

budget_amount.description: Budget amount as stated. 0 if not stated. Never estimate

location.description: City or region as stated. Empty string if not stated

timeline.description: Desired start or deadline in Ukrainian, as stated. Empty string if not stated

priority.description: Recommendation only: high = clear need + budget + near start or B2B volume; low = vague or very small

summary_uk.description: 2-3 sentence factual summary in Ukrainian for the sales manager

next_action_uk.description: One concrete next step for the manager in Ukrainian

reply_draft_uk.description: Short polite reply draft to the customer in Ukrainian asking for missing data if any. Do not promise prices or dates
